methods.label: Find when the denominator is zero
methods.explanation: An algebraic fraction is undefined when its denominator is 0: \(x^2-4=0\). Solving gives \(x=2\) or \(x=-2\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 8 denominator condition and Grade 7 square roots and equality properties.
